Notes to the Consolidated Financial Report 30 June 2019 (continued)

## 12 Leases

## (a) Leases

## (i) Amounts recognised in the Consolidated Balance Sheet

The Consolidated Balance Sheet includes the following amounts relating to leases:

|                       |   30 June 2019 $'000 | 30 June 2018 $'000   |
|-----------------------|----------------------|----------------------|
| Right-of-use assets * |                      |                      |
| Properties            |               68,569 | 5,070                |
| Motor Vehicles        |                  259 | -                    |
| Connectivity Links    |                9,696 | -                    |
|                       |               78,524 | 5,070                |

* included in the line item 'Property, plant and equipment' in the Consolidated Balance Sheet. In the previous year, the Group only recognised Right-of-use assets in relation to leases that were classified as 'finance leases' under AASB 117 Leases. For adjustments recognised on adoption of AASB 16 on 1 July 2018, please refer to note 30.

|                      |   30 June 2019 $'000 |   30 June 2018 $'000 |
|----------------------|----------------------|----------------------|
| Lease liabilities ** |                      |                      |
| Current              |                1,061 |                  307 |
| Non-current          |               72,267 |                5,735 |
|                      |               73,328 |                6,042 |

** In the previous year, the Group only recognised lease liabilities in relation to leases that were classified as 'finance leases' under AASB 117 Leases. For adjustments recognised on adoption of AASB 16 on 1 July 2018, please refer to note 30.

Additions to the right-of-use assets during the 2019 financial year were $0.3 million.

## (ii) Amounts recognised in the Consolidated Statement of Comprehensive Income

The Consolidated Statement of Comprehensive Income shows the following amounts relating to leases:

|                                              |   30 June 2019 $'000 | 30 June 2018 $'000   |
|----------------------------------------------|----------------------|----------------------|
| Depreciation charge on Properties            |                5,067 | -                    |
| Depreciation charge on Motor Vehicles        |                   68 | -                    |
| Depreciation charge on Connectivity Links    |                  423 | -                    |
| Interest expense (included in Finance costs) |                9,373 | -                    |
|                                              |               14,931 | -                    |

The total cash outflow for leases in 2019 was $8.6 million.

## (iii) The group's leasing activities and how these are accounted for

The Group has a number of leases over property, motor vehicles, and connectivity links that have varying terms, escalation clauses and renewal rights.
